newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba's Tietmeyer says EMU interpretation must wait.
newsitem.headline: Buba's Tietmeyer says EMU interpretation must wait.

text.p: Bundesbank President Hans Tietmeyer said on Tuesday that any interpretation of the criteria for EMU entry must await the formal evaluation period.

"That...has to wait for the formal evaluation period," Tietmeyer told a news conference after a Franco-German economic summit here, declining to comment on what kind, if any leniency, will applied in interpreting the criteria.
According to the Maastricht Treaty, political leaders will be asked to take decisions on which nations will be able to join the currency union when it begins on January 1, 1999.
Tietmeyer added the European Monetary Institute had a big role in determining the eventual interpretation of the criteria and would be reporting on the matter by the end of the year.
